purpose: Draft v2 current-page callback identity fence, no authentication/authorization rule change
implementation: Existing session-store closure read-only getRevision; increments on identity writes, applySnapshot, restore, clear before partial I/O; avatar/nickname unchanged
new_cases: Same timestamp and same token A→B→A
Same snapshot refresh/role/userType/OpenID, profile edits do not invalidate
Partial snapshot and clear I/O failures invalidate old work
Restore/single-field write failure invalidates old work
limits: Counter is process-local; original identity journal remains necessary across restarts
Page v2 not yet implemented; this getter alone does not fix existing Page callbacks
Direct writes outside session-store must be audited by each consumer; not a new authorization proof
